scope: Vanderbilt University / Washington University in St. Louis (WashU) / University of Notre Dame

test_policy.value: SAT/ACT 可选（test-optional）——适用于申请 2027 秋 与 2028 秋 入学的学生；自 2029 秋 入学起恢复为必须提交。官网未采用 GPA/标化硬性分数线（整体评估）。

schools.name: Washington University in St. Louis (WashU)

test_policy.value: Test-optional（不强制 SAT/ACT）。若提交：接受 SAT 或 ACT；接受 Common/Coalition App 自报分（self-reported）；ACT Science 为选考，取含/不含 Science 的 ACT Superscore 更高者；不要求 SAT Essay 或 ACT Writing；对 SAT/ACT 无偏好；任一年份考试成绩均可。
test_policy.season: 官方当前公布（Fall 2027 申请季起持续 test-optional；WashU 'has adopted a test optional policy'）

value.Financial aid deadlines: QuestBridge/EA/ED I Nov 17；ED II Jan 11；RD Feb 1；Transfer 与申请同月同截止

supplements.value: 必答 1 篇 WashU 专属 essay：主题为『你想在大学学什么、为何』（官网原文：'WashU has one required essay that is specific to us, where we ask you what you'd like to study and why'）。官网另提及可用 90 秒视频/若干 optional 题目补充，但 exact prompt 全文官网未在本页列出。

test_policy.value: Test-optional 至 2026-2027 申请季（含首年与转学，即申请 2027 秋入学不需提交）；自 2027-2028 申请季（申请 2028 秋入学）起恢复必须提交 ACT 或 SAT。

deadlines.season: 官方当前公布季（REA Nov 1 / RD Jan 4）
deadlines.source_note: 官网 'Don't Lose These Dates' 与 application-overview 双处一致。

supplements.value: Notre Dame Writing Supplement（需另行提交，随 Common/Coalition App 提交）：①必答 short essay，最多 150 词，题目全文：'Everyone has different priorities when considering their higher education options and building their college or university list. Tell us about your “non-negotiable” factor(s) when searching for your future college home.'；②从 4 题中选答 2 题，每题 50-100 词：1) How does faith influence the decisions you make? 2) What is distinctive about your personal experiences and development (eg, family support, culture, disability, personal background, community)? Why are these experiences important to you and how will you enrich the Notre Dame community? 3) Notre Dame's undergraduate experience is characterized by a collective sense of care for every person. How do you foster service to others in your community? 4) What would you fight for?；③另有 Academic 区 100 词题 'Briefly share what draws you to the area(s) of study you listed.'（仅在部分官方页提及）。
supplements.season: 官方当前公布（对应 2026-2027 申请季）
supplements.source_note: 官网原文确认：'one (1) required short essay question and two (2) short-answer responses...'；③ academic 100 词题出现在第三方转述的 Academics 区，官方 application-overview 页未列该题，标注为部分核实。
